meta.label: Adoption audit event mix
meta.description: Stream the host audit logs ($DIP_HOME/run/audit/audit.log*) and classify human events by msgType into build / run / explore / consume / other buckets (guarded-regex mining, no per-line JSON parse), plus per-human authSource split (UI vs API keys) and the top human event types. Automation identities (api:*, no:auth) are counted but never bucketed. Runs as the dataiku service account so it can read the local audit dir regardless of webapp impersonation.

params.name: max_files
params.label: Max rotated files to read (0 = all)
